# flexEngineV2 engine configuration reference

<!-- generated by `python -m flexengine2.config.refdoc` from src/flexengine2/config/schema.json; do not edit -->

flexEngineV2 engine configuration (`/etc/flexengine/engine.yaml`, JSON or YAML). Check a file with `flexengine config check <file> [--json] [--resolve]`.

- Unknown keys are errors at every level.
- `${VAR}` references are expanded from the environment before validation; an unset variable is an error.
- Paths are strings, taken as given (relative = relative to the working directory).
- A document with `apiVersion: flexengine/v2alpha1` (the plan §3.6 form) is converted to this canonical form first (`flexengine2.config.load.from_plan_v2`).
- `<name>` stands for a key you choose (e.g. a PLC target); `[]` for each list item; *[form]* marks keys of one alternative form.

| Key | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cloud` | object |  | yes | Connection to flexCloud and the trust anchors. Needs `apiUrl` or `stackInfo`, and `cloudPublicKey` or `stackInfo`. |
| `cloud.apiUrl` | string |  |  | Base URL of the flexCloud device API (CP-1), e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8700`. Taken from `stackInfo` when unset. |
| `cloud.cloudPublicKey` | string |  |  | Trust anchor for desired-state signatures (Ed25519, base64). Taken from `stackInfo` when unset. |
| `cloud.stackInfo` | string |  |  | demo/cloud's `stack.json`; fills `apiUrl` (its `internal.p2`, else `urls.p2`) and `cloudPublicKey` when they are unset. |
| `cloud.releasePublicKeys` | array of string | `[]` |  | Trusted release signing keys (Ed25519, base64). |
| `cloud.releaseKeyFiles` | array of string | `[]` |  | Ed25519 release key files (`flex release` key format, base64 private key); their public keys are added to `releasePublicKeys`. |
| `cloud.pollInterval` | number | `1.0` |  | Seconds between desired-state polls when nothing is in flight. |
| `cloud.backoff` | array [number, number] | `[0.25, 4.0]` |  | `[initial, maximum]` seconds of the exponential back-off while the cloud is unreachable. |
| `cloud.httpTimeout` | number | `5` |  | Timeout in seconds of one HTTP request to the cloud. |
| `cloud.healthEveryTicks` | integer | `3` |  | Run the health check of installed deployments every N engine ticks. |
| `cloud.safeStateFile` | string |  |  | Host-wide default of `devices[].safeStateFile`. |
| `dataDir` | string |  | yes | Root of the engine state. Each device keeps `<dataDir>/<deviceId>/` (state.json, actions.jsonl, driver state, device.key) unless it sets its own `dataDir`. |
| `model` | string |  |  | flexModel workspace directory used by the MCU relay (types, rmw_zenoh keys). Required when a relay is enabled and does not set `relay.model`. |
| `deployment` | string |  |  | Deployment id in `model` the MCU relay maps (e.g. `d_pick_lab`). Required when a relay is enabled and does not set `relay.deployment`. |
| `devices` | array of object |  | yes | The devices this host runs one engine each for (one host process, several device engines). |
| `devices[].deviceId` | string |  | yes | Device id as registered in flexCloud (e.g. `panda`, `panda.portenta`, `unoq`). Unique per host. |
| `devices[].role` | `gateway` \| `standalone-device` |  |  | Engine role reported in the capabilities. Default: `gateway` when another device names this one as `parent`, else `standalone-device`. Not allowed on an MCU child (always `child-device`). |
| `devices[].parent` | string |  |  | deviceId of the gateway an MCU child is attached to (see-thru mode). Only with `mcu`. |
| `devices[].modelDevice` | string |  |  | Device name of this device in the flexModel deployment (used by the MCU relay). |
| `devices[].link` | string |  |  | Free text describing the gateway-child link, reported in the gateway's capabilities (default `smp/uart`). |
| `devices[].onboardingToken` | string |  |  | One-time onboarding token (`POST /api/v1/admin/onboarding-tokens`). Only needed until the device is onboarded. |
| `devices[].onboardingTokenFile` | string |  |  | File holding the onboarding token; read into `onboardingToken` at load when that is unset. |
| `devices[].dataDir` | string |  |  | State directory of this device (default `<dataDir>/<deviceId>`). |
| `devices[].safeStateFile` | string |  |  | JSON file `{"machine_parked": bool, "operator_confirmed": bool}` with the safe-state signals that gate safety-relevant activations (FE-S6). Unset = no signal is ever true. |
| `devices[].pollInterval` | number | `1.0` |  | Per-device override of `cloud.pollInterval`. |
| `devices[].backoff` | array [number, number] | `[0.25, 4.0]` |  | Per-device override of `cloud.backoff`. |
| `devices[].httpTimeout` | number | `5` |  | Per-device override of `cloud.httpTimeout`. |
| `devices[].healthEveryTicks` | integer | `3` |  | Per-device override of `cloud.healthEveryTicks`. |
| `devices[].drivers` | object |  |  | Drivers of a (non-MCU) device; a device only gets the drivers it lists. |
| `devices[].drivers.container` | object |  |  | OCI container driver. `runtime: docker\|podman` uses the CLI driver, `runtime: ankaios` the Ankaios driver. |
| `devices[].drivers.container.runtime` | `docker` \| `podman` \| `ankaios` |  | yes | Container executor (`quadlet` is planned, not in alpha). |
| `devices[].drivers.container.ankBin` | string |  | yes | *[runtime: ankaios]* Path of the `ank` CLI. |
| `devices[].drivers.container.serverUrl` | string |  | yes | *[runtime: ankaios]* Ankaios server URL, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:25551`. |
| `devices[].drivers.container.agent` | string |  | yes | *[runtime: ankaios]* Ankaios agent name workloads are placed on. |
| `devices[].drivers.container.allowedRunOptions` | object | `{}` |  | *[runtime: docker \| podman]* Allow-list of the `runOptions` a signed release may request; anything else fails the deployment (S4). |
| `devices[].drivers.container.allowedRunOptions.devices` | array of string |  |  | Permitted `--device` values, e.g. `/dev/dri`. |
| `devices[].drivers.container.allowedRunOptions.gpus` | array of string |  |  | Permitted `--gpus` values, e.g. `all`. |
| `devices[].drivers.container.allowedRunOptions.runtime` | array of string |  |  | Permitted `--runtime` values, e.g. `nvidia`. |
| `devices[].drivers.container.allowedRunOptions.groupAdd` | array of string |  |  | Permitted `--group-add` values. |
| `devices[].drivers.native` | boolean | `false` |  | `true` adds the native process driver (tests only; the systemd native driver is not in alpha). |
| `devices[].drivers.plc-verify` | object |  |  | PLC interface verification (no download to the PLC): reads the running interface hash and holds/gates deployments on it. |
| `devices[].drivers.plc-verify.plcs` | map | `{}` |  | PLC target (as in `flex-plc.json` `target` or the `plc` parameter, e.g. `panda/cx`, `opta`) -> connection. |
| `devices[].drivers.plc-verify.plcs.<name>.via` | `ads` \| `modbus` \| `shm` |  | yes | Transport: Beckhoff ADS, Modbus/TCP, or the shared-memory RT host of the SIL. |
| `devices[].drivers.plc-verify.plcs.<name>.amsNetId` | string |  | yes | *[via: ads]* AMS Net ID of the PLC, e.g. `192.168.50.30.1.1`. |
| `devices[].drivers.plc-verify.plcs.<name>.ip` | string |  | yes | *[via: ads]* IP address of the PLC. |
| `devices[].drivers.plc-verify.plcs.<name>.amsPort` | integer | `851` |  | *[via: ads]* AMS port of the PLC runtime (default from the release's flex-plc.json, else 851). |
| `devices[].drivers.plc-verify.plcs.<name>.localNetId` | string |  |  | *[via: ads]* Local AMS Net ID of the ADS client (needed on Linux). |
| `devices[].drivers.plc-verify.plcs.<name>.timeout` | number | `2.0` |  | *[via: ads; via: modbus]* Read timeout in seconds. |
| `devices[].drivers.plc-verify.plcs.<name>.instance` | string | `"MAIN.fbBridge"` |  | *[via: ads]* Bridge FB instance (the release's flex-plc.json `instance` wins). |
| `devices[].drivers.plc-verify.plcs.<name>.host` | string |  | yes | *[via: modbus]* Modbus/TCP server host. |
| `devices[].drivers.plc-verify.plcs.<name>.port` | integer | `502` |  | *[via: modbus]* Modbus/TCP port (default from the release's flex-plc.json, else 502). |
| `devices[].drivers.plc-verify.plcs.<name>.unitId` | integer | `1` |  | *[via: modbus]* Modbus unit id. |
| `devices[].drivers.plc-verify.plcs.<name>.path` | string |  |  | *[via: shm]* Shared-memory region of the RT host (default `/dev/shm/<bridge>` of the release). |
| `devices[].drivers.plc-verify.cacheSeconds` | number | `0.5` |  | How long a read interface hash is reused. |
| `devices[].drivers.applab` | object |  |  | Arduino App Lab driver (UNO Q) over `arduino-app-cli`, locally or over SSH (remote mode). |
| `devices[].drivers.applab.board` | string | `"unoq"` |  | Board name. |
| `devices[].drivers.applab.cli` | string | `"arduino-app-cli"` |  | `arduino-app-cli` binary (on the board in remote mode). |
| `devices[].drivers.applab.routerSocket` | string | `"/var/run/arduino-router.sock"` |  | arduino-router socket used by `healthVia: router`. |
| `devices[].drivers.applab.healthVia` | `router` \| `logs` | `"router"` |  | Health source of the App: router RPC or app logs. Default `logs` when `ssh` is set. |
| `devices[].drivers.applab.takeoverForeignApps` | boolean | `false` |  | Stop an App the engine did not start instead of failing. |
| `devices[].drivers.applab.keepReleases` | integer | `2` |  | Installed App releases kept for rollback. |
| `devices[].drivers.applab.cliTimeout` | number | `600` |  | Timeout in seconds of one CLI call. |
| `devices[].drivers.applab.ssh` | string |  |  | Remote mode: `user@host` of the board (the engine runs elsewhere). |
| `devices[].drivers.applab.sshCmd` | array of string | `["ssh", "-o", "BatchMode=yes"]` |  | SSH command prefix (remote mode). |
| `devices[].drivers.applab.scpCmd` | array of string | `["scp", "-q", "-o", "BatchMode=yes"]` |  | SCP command prefix (remote mode). |
| `devices[].drivers.applab.remoteStaging` | string | `"/tmp/flex-applab"` |  | Staging directory on the board (remote mode). |
| `devices[].mcu` | object |  |  | Makes the device an MCU child (see-thru): mcu-module and mcu-firmware drivers over SMP (mcumgr). Needs `parent`; no `drivers`. |
| `devices[].mcu.smp` | object |  | yes | SMP link: either `{host, port}` (TCP: QEMU or a serial-to-TCP bridge) or `{tty, baud}` (serial, accepted by the schema, implemented later: d2-prep request R5). |
| `devices[].mcu.smp.tty` | string |  | yes | *[serial form (accepted by schema, implemented later: R5)]* Serial device of the SMP UART, e.g. `/dev/ttyUSB0` (pyserial, no socat). Accepted by the schema, implemented later (R5). |
| `devices[].mcu.smp.baud` | integer | `115200` |  | *[serial form (accepted by schema, implemented later: R5)]* Baud rate of the SMP UART. |
| `devices[].mcu.smp.host` | string |  | yes | *[TCP form]* SMP-over-TCP host (QEMU serial socket or socat bridge). |
| `devices[].mcu.smp.port` | integer |  | yes | *[TCP form]* SMP-over-TCP port. |
| `devices[].mcu.modulePublicKey` | string |  | yes | Raw P-256 public key (x\|\|y, 64 bytes as hex) of the FLXM module signing key. |
| `devices[].mcu.timeout` | number | `10` |  | SMP request timeout in seconds. |
| `devices[].relay` | object |  |  | MCU <-> Zenoh relay (rmw_zenoh keys of the MCU modules). Only on an MCU child. |
| `devices[].relay.enabled` | boolean | `false` |  | Run the relay. |
| `devices[].relay.maxRateHz` | number | `10` |  | Sampling rate MCU -> Zenoh (capped at 10 Hz). |
| `devices[].relay.connect` | string \| null |  |  | Zenoh endpoint to connect to (zenohd / rmw_zenoh router). Unset or null = none. |
| `devices[].relay.listen` | string \| null |  |  | Zenoh endpoint to listen on. Unset or null = none. |
| `devices[].relay.mode` | `peer` \| `client` | `"peer"` |  | Zenoh session mode. |
| `devices[].relay.zenoh` | boolean | `true` |  | `false` runs the relay without a Zenoh session (tests). |
| `devices[].relay.model` | string |  |  | flexModel workspace (default: top-level `model`). |
| `devices[].relay.deployment` | string |  |  | Deployment id (default: top-level `deployment`). |
| `devices[].relay.modelDevice` | string |  |  | Device name in the model (default: the device's `modelDevice`). |
| `local` | object |  |  | Local operator API (CP-7, EV-07): HTTP over a Unix socket (every operation) and an optional read-only TCP bind with a bearer token (GET only). The CLI (`flexengine status\|deployments\|logs\|history\|bundle import`) uses the socket and falls back to reading the data directories when the engine is not running. |
| `local.socket` | string | `"/run/flexengine/api.sock"` |  | Path of the API Unix socket (created mode 0660; its directory is created when missing). |
| `local.group` | string |  |  | Group that owns the socket (e.g. `flex`), so its members can use the API and the CLI. Unset = the engine's primary group. |
| `local.tcp` | object |  |  | Optional read-only TCP bind for the desk runbooks: GET operations only, each with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Unset = no TCP listener. |
| `local.tcp.bind` | string |  | yes | `host:port` to listen on, e.g. `127.0.0.1:8781` (`[::1]:8781` for IPv6). |
| `local.tcp.tokenFile` | string |  | yes | File holding the bearer token (mode 0600, owned by the engine user; read once at start). |
